subject: Shiny and real-time hookup to Oracle

messages.author: 77657e4bc4b5e029
messages.subject: Shiny and real-time hookup to Oracle
parts:
Hi fellows,

I am having trouble to get it to finally work for my test shiny app to talk to Oracle DB.  But I believe I am getting very close.


# ui.R

library(shiny)
library(ROracle)
library(ggplot2)

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Prototype Shiny"),

  mainPanel(
    h3("DB query output"),
    dataTableOutput("anzk")
  )
))

# server.R

library(shiny)
library(ROracle)
library(ggplot2)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    drv <- dbDriver("Oracle")
    con <- dbConnect(drv,username="xxxx",password="xxxx",dbname="xxxxxx.cllra7bwmgfk.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com:1521/xxxxxx")
    res <- dbSendQuery(con, "select * from patients")

    art_res <- fetch(res)
    dbDisconnect(con)

    output$anzk <- renderTable({art_res})
})

I am expecting to see some data from Oracle query in browser when I run shiny app.  The app is on my Ubuntu shiny server, where I have had other shiny apps work.  But I am seeing no data in browser.


I have taken care of installing R package “ROracle”.  I have installed Oracle client on shiny server and taken care of “LD_LIBRARY_PATH”:

parts: dataTableOutput and renderTable are not compatible with each other. You must either use dataTableOutput and renderDataTable, or, tableOutput and renderTable.
